description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
The Reflection of Kiki-Jiki token enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Goblin and Shaman you control.
Activate the token Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the nontoken Reflection of Kiki-Jiki with haste.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
